title: Software hiring funnel stage rates
population: Large-company SWE/FDE pipelines (mechanistic prior, not personalized calibration)
definition: Independent-candidate stage pass rates used to propagate an active pipeline toward an offer. Rates are associative/mechanistic priors, not fitted personal offer probabilities.
limitations: No frozen public dataset calibrates personal offer probability for an arbitrary target-company set.
Parallel processes are treated as independent; correlated rejections are not modeled.
Practice volume is activity evidence only and does not inject a latent strength score.
Personal stage rates use only resolved passes and rejections, shrunk toward these priors. They are not a calibrated classifier and are not estimated from JTH.
permitted_use: baseline hazard derivation and exploratory scenario perturbation

claims.claim: Stage rates are frozen mechanistic priors for funnel propagation; they are not LLM-assigned probabilities.
